claims.reasoning: LAC's got the bye and we can't leave a starting spot empty - that's not how we do things. Houston's shown up and done their job all year against a banged-up Giants team, and $14 is a fair price for a genuine hole, not a panic buy. Letting Lawrence go - he's not even playing this week, and we've got Jones out there earning it with Cousins settled in behind him.

note_reply: No note this week, and that's fine - we don't need somebody in the stands to tell us where we stand. Two of our fellas are on a bye and a third's banged up, so we go find a defense that'll show up and do its job, same as everybody else in this locker room. Clear eyes, full hearts - we keep building it right whether anybody's watching or not.
